name: Nordic Network
description: Sigrid's vault community has built supply relationships with five Scandinavian settlements, but two have gone quiet. She needs someone to visit each settlement, determine their status, and re-establish contact if possible.

stages.name: Visit the Oslo Settlement
stages.description: Travel to the Oslo ruins where one of Sigrid's partner settlements has gone quiet. Determine whether the silence is technical failure or something more serious.

stages.name: Visit the Copenhagen Settlement
stages.description: Cross into Denmark to find the Copenhagen settlement. It was the most productive of Sigrid's supply partners — its silence is the most alarming.

stages.name: Report Back to Sigrid
stages.description: Return to Stockholm with a full account of both settlements' status. Sigrid will need to make decisions about the network based on what you've found.
